reasons.reader_question: The last lines ('Hands go where they're sent' / 'whose palm was open') hand the reader a specific question, and the planted green-wax gift lets them guess. The final line spells the question out a little too neatly.
reasons.change: Neela leaves rogue, masterless and resin-poor, now bound to Devan's body. Devan moves from suspecting Ittan to facing him and seeing that someone above Ittan sent him.
reasons.romance_movement: The reason for the change is new. Shared wounds make his pain hers, and his offer of the warden's house ('I'd like it to have someone who is') makes them each other's only household. This matches the beat.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Chemistry comes entirely through action: he binds her wrists without touching the open parts, 'Then I'll bleed in pairs', he offers his shoulder, 'I'll be here', and her knee moves against the bay's flank. Nothing is narrated.
reasons.character_logic: Neela waters and feeds forty-one locked cages, then leaves them shut in an abandoned compound where they will starve within days, which defeats her own stated aim. Devan's POV notes clove scent and brick-red stain, his own wax evidence, with no flicker of recognition, which reads as the POV withholding.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Every fight now costs both bodies. She is hunted and has no gate but his. Tomorrow's search has to succeed with Ittan under his roof tonight. Ammu's death stays real.
reasons.prose: Clean, concrete and restrained, with no banned phrases, no em dashes and grief written without melodrama. A few lines muddle meaning: 'old ridge of a scar that was not his', 'as the dawn had turned her back', 'said Ittan Keeper of the Passes' (missing comma). 'He did not' openings stack up in places.
reasons.continuity: 'On the thirty-ninth day' conflicts with the established count. The new moon was ch23+6 (about day 38), the binding was at the second dusk after it (about day 40, F244), and they ride home the day after. Day 39 is when Devan lay poisoned or was riding to the Resin House. 'Due two days ago' also puts the Keeper past the ch23+8 sealing (F206).

fixes: At 'On the thirty-ninth day, the Keeper of the Passes came up' (continuity, timeline). The binding was the second dusk after the new moon (F244), so day 39 had Devan poisoned or on the road, and 'due two days ago' pushes the Keeper past the ch23+8 sealing (F206). Replace the day number with a relative marker that fits the count, e.g. 'Two days after they rode in'. Make the delay say the charter sealing waits on the Keeper's own seal, so a late Keeper delays the closing, and keep Devan's reading that Ittan was waiting for news of a dead warden. Update F260 to match.

At 'But she could refuse to leave them shut in to starve, and she had' (irrational behaviour). One trough-fill does not save forty-one locked animals in an abandoned compound. A smart Neela either opens the cages and the end door so they can forage, accepting that the open won't heal them, or makes Muthu or Devan agree to send fort men back within days to feed them. Add two or three lines of that choice, keeping her line that a caging can't be undone.

At 'which she felt him feel from the step outside' and 'as a man knows which way a door is' (convenient magic, rule widened). The bond transmits wounds, not flinches, moods or location. Cut 'felt him feel', 'a very small answering ease in her own ribs' and Devan's door-sense. Keep only pain felt at a shared wound (her torn wrist pulling at his right wrist works). Then add one beat in Devan's POV where the clove and brick-red stain register as council wax (F050) so the POV isn't withholding what he knows.
reader_question: If Ittan is only a hand that goes where it's sent, whose hand is he, and who paid for Devan's death above him?
new_facts_assessment: new-facts.json is empty, but the draft adds facts, and continuity.json already holds F257-F261 from this chapter. All of them should be listed. Ammu's cached Valli bundle and resin pouch are necessary and consistent (F084, F257). Devan's red lines at throat and wrists (F258) are useful, but the bond formed after the forced tearing, so it needs one line making clear the scars were still bleeding through the turning, when the bond was live. Ittan's clove smell and brick-red stain (F259) are an excellent clue at the peak and match F050. The low cart and roped chest are needed for ch29. Ittan's wife's cough of three winters fits his bible contradiction. The date 'thirty-ninth day' and 'due two days ago' (F260) conflict with the timeline. One addition is undeclared and widens the wound-share rule: the bond shares wounds only (F009), yet the draft has Neela feel 'a small answering ease' and Devan 'known for an hour that she was there, as a man knows which way a door is'. That is a location and emotion sense the rule never set up, so cut it or log and justify it.
